dummy_template.flows:
flow:
  name: keboola_test_flow
  description: "End-to-end flow to read from a file, analyze it, and write the result."
  agents:
    - file_analyst
  tasks:
    - read_input_file_task
    - process_file_data_task
    - write_output_file_task
  process: sequential
dummy_template.tasks:
tasks:
  read_input_file_task:
    description: >
      Read the files.

      You MUST read the file, parse it as CSV, and return the content.
    expected_output: >
      The content of the input CSV file as a string.
    agent: file_analyst

  process_file_data_task:
    description: >
      Use the CSV data from the previous task and perform any transformation you like.
      For this example, just count how many rows the file contains and return that number.
    expected_output: >
      A single line summary: "Row count: X"
    agent: file_analyst

  write_output_file_task:
    description: >
      Create a new CSV file in the file directory called "test_output.csv"

      Format
      - A single row with the header "Summary"
      - A second row with the summary from the previous step

      Example:
      Summary
      Row count: X
    expected_output: >
      Confirmation that the output file was written successfully.
    agent: file_analyst
dummy_template.agents:
agents:
  file_analyst:
    role: "Data analyst working on Keboola files"
    goal: "Extract insights from input file and prepare the output"
    backstory: "You are an AI tool embedded in Keboola to analyze and transform file-based data."
    tools:
      - read_keboola_table_tool
      - read_keboola_file_tool
      - download_keboola_data_tool
      - write_keboola_file_tool
